en: Dependent on a wholesome state with applied thought and sustained thought (*savitakkasavicāra*), a state that is neither with applied and sustained thought nor wholesome arises by way of root condition (*hetupaccaya*) … three.

Dependent on a wholesome state without applied thought but with sustained thought (*avitakkavicāramatta*), a state that is neither without applied and sustained thought nor wholesome arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. In the case of root condition there are fifteen; in the case of predominance condition there are fifteen … pe … in the case of non-disappearance condition there are fifteen.

Dependent on an unwholesome state accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought, a state that is neither accompanied by applied thought and sustained thought nor unwholesome arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Nine in the case of root; nine in the case of predominance ... [and so on] ... nine in the case of non-disappearance.
